title: Adding COinS Metadata for Zotero
text: Without COinS, Zotero guess post’s metadata examining HTML structure. often fails blog posts : Blog post titles might <h1> tag, might many things publication date might hidden obscure <time> element embedded longer text string Authors rarely marked consistently across different blog platforms Categories tags standard HTML representation

title: Adding COinS Metadata for Zotero
text: COinS entry built key-value pairs describe published work. main fields blog post : Additional optional fields can include: - rft.pub — Publication/blog name - rft.spage, rft.epage — Page numbers (applicable blog posts) - rft.issn — Journal ISSN (applicable blog posts) - rft.language — Language code (e.g., “en-US”)

title: Adding COinS Metadata for Zotero
text: COinS based OpenURL standard (ANSI/NISO Z39.88-2004), originally designed help libraries link users full-text content. “ContextObject” standardized metadata package heart OpenURL. clever part COinS embeds OpenURL ContextObject invisibly HTML using <span> element: class="Z3988" tells processors like Zotero span contains COinS metadata. actual data title attribute (counterintuitive—’s displayed tooltip; ’s just container encoded metadata).
